pattern: Generated cards fill the background with many small props the subject doesn't name and with invented decoration such as confetti, string lights, spark or knock lines, corner foliage, scattered tufts and glowing button clusters. Real cards show the place as a few large, quiet shapes. In the object lessons the giveaways run the same way: a bright halo behind the object, a full island or base added under a subject the real card crops, and a tabletop surface with no edge in place of a real desk front.
